scope: Actual Firefox156.0.1/157.0 on macOS:10 first-paint/hydration,120 consumer and40 workflow cases. Existing production assets and packed consumer fixtures reused; no new build/install/types claim.
remaining: Computed descriptions, full native AX trees, axe and spoken output
Remaining original Playwright assertions including history and accessibility variants
Other OSes, physical devices and manual IME/AT acceptance
earlyTargetPolicy: While module responses are held, known original native DOM inputs receive native keyboard input. After release, browser-computed name/role lookup must return the exact same shared node ID. No computed accessibility lookup during the held-module phase is claimed.
scriptPolicy: Fresh per-case Firefox profile only; no-JS cases write javascript.enabled=false in that isolated profile. Inline/external canaries prove disabled and enabled states. User profiles and browser settings remain unchanged.

attempts.disposition: Disabled-page async evaluation timed out; synchronous protocol inspection is required. Failed evidence retained.
No-JS passed; held-module accessibility lookup stalled. Owned processes were stopped, exact dead leases archived/recovered with receipts. Aborted, not passed.
Bounded retry identifies browsingContext.locateNodes timeout while modules are held; use native DOM targets early and computed-name identity after release.
Initial10 passes before closed-socket guard; final170-case run above requalifies all users of the updated transport.
